name: Lumbar Spine MR Segmentation
description: Segmentation of lumbar vertebrae and related spinal structures in MR images to evaluate automatic spine segmentation algorithms.
reputation: Moderately used in the medical imaging community for spine segmentation research but not a single dominant public benchmark.
notes: Annotation variability and class imbalance across spinal structures; dataset sizes may be limited; modality differences (scanner/protocol) affect generalization; privacy constraints limit data availability; non-LLM benchmark.
